issues.description: Field 'numberOfLecturers' has a type mismatch across artifacts: the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares numberOfLecturers as int (line 67), whereas the reference solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declares the field as byte (line 9) and uses byte for the constructor parameter (line 13) and the setter parameter (line 50). This inconsistency can confuse students about the intended type (and which type to use in their constructor/setter) and may lead to implementations that differ from the reference or from tests that expect int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfLecturers consistent across artifacts. Recommended: change the solution's field, constructor parameter, and setter/getter signatures to use int to match the UML and problem statement. Alternatively, if byte is intentionally required, update the UML and all related documentation/tests to specify byte instead — but prefer int for clarity and to avoid surprising learners.
